appName.description: Recommended English Chrome Web Store name; retain AI Translator brand.

appDescription.message: Translate text with AI and keep local history. Pro adds webpage translation, tone and optional context.
appDescription.description: Recommended English short description, maximum 132 characters.

reviewPrompt.message: Enjoying AI Translator? Rate it on the Chrome Web Store

welcomeIntro.message: Translate typed or selected text with AI. Pro also translates webpages and can restore the original text.

welcomePin.message: Pin AI Translator to the toolbar and open it.

welcomeSignIn.message: Sign in with Google and choose your translation languages.

welcomeFirstResult.message: Paste text into the popup or select text on a webpage and click the translate icon. Page translation requires Pro.

welcomeAllowance.message: Free includes 100,000 source characters per calendar month and up to 4,000 per translation. Pro includes 2,000,000 per monthly subscription window and up to 50,000 per translation, for $4.99/month or $39.99/year.

welcomePrivacy.message: Translation text is sent for server-side AI processing. Instant selection sends selected text automatically when enabled. Pro page translation also processes newly appearing page text; optional page context sends up to 2,000 visible surrounding characters. Translation history stays on this device, separated by account, with no cloud sync.
